穆 in the Liu annotation is the same person as 趙穆 (Zhao Mu), coreferent with the 穆 in annotation-001 and with 趙穆 in the main text. The candidate c0 is 穆, matching the surface directly. The annotation shows 太傅越 writing a letter to 穆, establishing this person as one of the three 叅軍.

The mention 穆 refers to 趙穆 (Zhao Mu). The Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-08-shangyu-034-liu-annotation-001) explicitly states '曰穆字季子/趙吳郡行狀', identifying 穆 as the person whose 行狀 is titled 趙吳郡行狀, i.e., 趙穆 who served as 吳郡太守. The main text (sfh1-ev-08-shangyu-034-main) confirms that 穆 is one of the three 參軍 (王趙鄧三參軍) alongside 王安期 and 鄧伯道, and the annotation identifies these as 安期, 鄧伯道, and 趙穆. The candidate c0 (穆) matches this historical referent. Additional annotations (sfh1-ev-08-shangyu-034-liu-annotation-002 and -005) provide biographical details consistent with 趙穆: he was 汲郡人, served as 尚書郎 and 太傅參軍, and later became 吳郡太守 and 封南鄉侯, and was 晉明帝師. The candidate is the correct historical referent.
